comment: WB2 class registry (S-G-2, S-D-3). Row per playable class; id 0 = Protocol.ClassId.WARRIOR. The combat stats here feed shared/sim/formulas.gd: armor and the per-school resistances reduce incoming damage, attack_power scales ability base_damage, crit_chance/hit_chance drive the deterministic crit/miss rolls. `abilities` is the class's known-ability list validated against abilities.json ids. WARRIOR keeps the frozen MVP parity (attack_power 0, armor 0, no crit, always hits) so the existing kill loop is unchanged; future classes just add rows here.
